The most widely recognized Pantone reference for “Sky Blue” is **Pantone 14‑4318** (also listed as “Sky Blue” in the Pantone Color Bridge).  

> **Pantone 14‑4318 – Sky Blue**  
> - RGB: 135 / 206 / 235  
> - CMYK: 0 / 0 / 10 / 0  
> - Hex: #87CEEB  

Pantone offers many other sky‑blue variations (e.g., 14‑4319, 15‑4320, etc.), so if you need a specific shade or a color that matches a particular design requirement, let me know and I can help narrow it down!
